_note: Piecewise map from the pinned build's file offsets to this build's. Roland re-packed .rdata between releases: the table DATA is the same (see "ab_test" in versions.json) but it was split and re-ordered, so fragmented tables have no single base address. Resolve a table by intersecting its pinned range with these segments. Built by tools/segment_map.py; every segment is verified byte-equal.
